newsitem.title: FINLAND: Two Finns die in Greenland ski challenge.
newsitem.headline: Two Finns die in Greenland ski challenge.

text.p: Two young Finns died and a third had to be rescued five days into an attempt to ski across Greenland, one of the toughest challenges in the Nordic region, daily Helsingin Sanomat said on Friday.
The men died of hypothermia as they were too exhausted to pitch tents or dig holes in the snow in sever cold and strong wind, Finland's leading daily said.

The expedition received heavy pre-publicity in Finland, with the men pictured in Sunday's paper smiling amid their 300 kg (660 lb) of equipment, as well as practising tent-pitching in tough conditions.

Survivor Timo Polari said he struggled to help his friends -- 26-year old data consultant Ari Mattila and 27-year-old student Tommi Heinonen. But he said a rescue helicopter came too late -- six hours after the men raised the alarm.
